note: Per-dungeon final boss mob codes, used to auto-mark a dungeon run complete (and rankable) when the party kills the final boss, without manual configuration. Keyed by catalog dungeonId; each value is every mob code sharing the final boss's name in that dungeon (its HP-bar phases / variants). Derived from the community NPC catalog (isBoss + dungeonId) by taking the highest-code real boss per dungeon, then hand-checked against known AION 2 final bosses. Placeholder ('None') and training ('(Specimen)') entries are excluded. Dungeons with no single verifiable final boss are omitted (the 300-boss Nightmare hub 200003; the Blazing Guardian Sword / Kaldrix raids 620021-620022) and simply do not auto-rank until confirmed. A manual final_boss_ids override still wins.

derived_note: Dungeon tiers the catalog names but attributes no NPC to (so no final boss could be curated for them): each takes its sibling tiers' final boss under every catalog code of that boss (same name, boss flag and three-digit code suffix -- the pattern every curated entry follows). Any of those codes dying in that instance completes the run; a code that cannot spawn there never matters. Curated entries win; tiers without a curated sibling (Citadel of the Fallen Daeva 600151-600153) stay unmapped.
